objective: Keep map terminals at the user-selected scrollback position while they inspect older output
requirements: Wheel scrolling on a map terminal reveals older output without being pulled back to the newest output
New output still follows the bottom when the user has not manually scrolled away
The behavior is covered by a focused regression and the installed release remains buildable
knownFailures: Map terminal output forced the viewport back to the newest section during scrollback
A scrollback fix must not disable normal live-output bottom following
outOfScope: Changing terminal daemon ownership or persistence
Changing the unrelated close and restart recovery behavior

successCriteria: The installed release identity check passes
failureSignals: Wheel navigation schedules a forced scroll to the newest output
The installed release cannot be verified

sure.rootCause: The output update path always scheduled a bottom scroll after map-terminal input, including wheel navigation.
sure.research: The focused regression exercises wheel navigation and the existing build and installed-release checks cover the delivery surface.
sure.fix: Mark wheel navigation as user-controlled viewport input and suppress only the next forced bottom-follow.
sure.sideEffects: Normal typing and live output continue to follow the bottom when the user has not scrolled away.
